heading: Agent
text: A person, organization, group, or software agent that performs a role. The role may add additional properties to the agent.

heading: ITSAgentThing
text: Added for organizational purposes to identify classes defined in the Agent part of the ITS Ontology.

heading: Role
text: A role that an agent can perform. The role may add additional properties to the agent.

heading: ITSAgentObjectProperty
text: An object property to organize all object properties defined in the ITS Agent Ontology.

heading: playsRole
text: Indicates the role that an agent performs.
